title: Grateful Dead Live at Felt Forum, Madison Square Garden on 1971-12-04
lineage: SBD> MR> DAT> C> DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 12/4/71 Felt Forum show with a smoking Smokestack Lightning and tight band play captured on a solid soundboard recording despite minor bass‑drum distortion.
ai_review.review: The December 4, 1971 Felt Forum performance is hailed for its blues‑rock fire, especially Pigpen’s incendiary “Smokestack Lightning” and the rolling Other One → Mexicali Blues → Other One sequence.  The soundboard source delivers overall clear mix and excellent instrument separation, though a few listeners note occasional bass‑drum mic distortion and brief cuts between songs.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars, praising performance and only citing minor recording glitches; weighted average of strong show quality (≈4.6) and good soundboard quality (≈4.0) yields a ~4.4 rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear, well‑balanced mix; occasional bass‑drum microphone distortion and a few song‑to‑song cuts noted by some listeners.

standout_songs: The Other One > Mexicali Blues > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: Blues‑rock heavy set with classic early‑70s Dead material; the sequencing feels natural despite a slightly shuffled track list noted by one reviewer.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Jerry's guitar tone on the first Truckin' lead is described as sweet and BB King‑like.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass is praised for its pounding power, though a battery/mic issue caused occasional distortion.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob is mentioned as part of a tight rhythm section; no specific solo remarks.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith is noted as fully integrated and delivering solid organ work; piano shows some distortion peaks.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy's bass‑drum mic picks up a funky distortion/vibration at times.
